text:
Alex K: Quick follow-up from the kv-eviction postmortem — we need to lock down owners/timelines for remediation + the tests we promised (regression suite, promptset, and a short chaos drill).
Priya S: I can own the regression test (kv pressure + long-tail reads). Targeting a first PR by EOD Thursday. :+1:
Jordan M: I’ll take promptset curation — need to convert the incident transcripts into 12 canonical prompts and edge cases. ETA next Tue.
Sam T: I’ll add a short load test job to CI to exercise heavy cold-cache cases, and a teardown/verify step. Plan to spike today and open PR tomorrow.
Maya R: ops-bot has created a reminder for the drill window. I’ll coordinate on oncall coverage. @ops-bot schedule
ops-bot: Reminder created: "kv-eviction chaos drill" on 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC. Assigned: Maya R, Sam T, Priya S.
Alex K: Thanks — can we also add a small automated regression that asserts KV cache TTL and eviction rate stays within expected range under synthetic load? Something that fails fast if eviction jumps.
Priya S: Good call. Proposed check: daily cron job that runs a 5m load with 50k keys and asserts eviction_rate < 0.02. If > threshold, post to #incidents.
Jordan M: For promptset, I’ll include examples that triggered the fallback path and one that produced degraded quality (we saw truncation + hallucination). Will document expected outputs.
Sam T: Example CI job snippet I’ll add to the repo:```yaml
jobs:
  kv_regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./tests/run_kv_pressure.sh --keys 50000 --duration 300
      - run: ./tests/check_eviction_rate.sh --threshold 0.02
```
Maya R: For the chaos drill, let's practice escalation + fallback to smaller model variant and routing to a different region. Add playbook checklist please.
Alex K: Action list (from this thread):
- Priya: regression job + daily cron (PR by Thu)
- Jordan: promptset + expected outputs (PR by Tue)
- Sam: load test CI job + docs (PR tomorrow)
- Maya: schedule drill + playbook (coordinator)
- Alex: follow up on rollout policy to ensure automatic fallback is enabled in staging
Please paste PR links here when ready.
Priya S: Will paste PR link once opened.
Jordan M: Will add TODOs in the promptset doc and link after PR.
Sam T: Spiking now, will post logs in thread.
Maya R: I’ve added the playbook draft to the runbooks repo and invited @oncall for the drill slot.
Alex K: Thanks all — we’ll sync in the postmortem follow-up meeting Friday 10:30am PT. If anything slips, escalate in this thread. :eyes:
